description: One vacancy in a 255-atom Cu cell with MACE-MPA-0 (Float32, Metal) at 1300 K (constant volume, Bussi); an illustration of the tracker, not a diffusion measurement

settings.noise: Philox4x32-10, one key per step from Xoshiro
settings.state_across_segments: positions, velocities, generator, tracker and series are stored at the end of each segment and continue exactly; a resumed run starts from the last stored segment
settings.volume: fixed at the lattice constant of the zero-temperature crystal
settings.provenance_note: Library code identical to cbc9480 (the docstring and comment edits to ext/ and src/ were made after the run's code was loaded); harness uncommitted at run time, committed in 3916d67 and byte-identical to it: no edit of md_validation.jl or validation_criteria.jl was made between the first run and the commit.

md_float32_cpu_baseline.note: The device and the CPU baseline draw their noise from different generators (Philox and Xoshiro), so the runs are statistically independent.
